description: Source code for TCPStore and TCPClient classes managing distributed TCP-based key-value store, including server lifecycle, client connections, data transfer, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: TCPServer
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of a TCP server, including starting, caching, and providing server info.

classes.name: TCPClient
classes.description: Handles client-side TCP socket connection, data sending, receiving, and timeout configuration.

classes.name: SendBuffer
classes.description: Buffers data to send over TCP, manages flushing based on watermarks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts or retrieves a cached TCPServer instance based on options.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection to a given address with options and backoff.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets socket receive timeout.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the TCPStore instance.

methods.name: waitForWorkers
methods.description: Blocks until all expected workers have connected.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Sends validation request to server.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Verifies network connectivity with server.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store.

methods.name: compareSet
methods.description: Performs compare-and-swap operation on a key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves value for a key.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Internal method to get value for a key.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Atomically adds a delta to a key's value.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store.

methods.name: incrementValueBy
methods.description: Increments a key's value by a delta.

methods.name: getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns total number of keys.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if keys are ready.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for keys to be available.

methods.name: doWait
methods.description: Internal wait implementation with timeout handling.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data to a key.

methods.name: multiGet
methods.description: Retrieves multiple keys.

methods.name: multiSet
methods.description: Sets multiple keys.

methods.name: queuePush
methods.description: Pushes data into a queue (not implemented on legacy backend).

methods.name: queuePop
methods.description: Pops data from a queue (not implemented on legacy backend).

methods.name: queueLen
methods.description: Gets queue length (not implemented on legacy backend).

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys with a specific prefix.

methods.name: hasExtendedApi
methods.description: Indicates extended API support.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Returns string representation of the store or client.
